title: NavLinkRenderProps
summary: Values passed to NavLink styling and children callbacks.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Contains isActive and isPending booleans. isActive uses pathname matching; end disables descendant matching. isPending matches the pending navigation destination using the same pathname and end rules.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: isPending follows page navigation, including retained views. It does not include independent fetcher activity.
